diagnosis: Invasive ductal carcinoma, no special type (NST), right breast upper outer quadrant; Nottingham grade 2, 1.8 cm, no lymphovascular invasion, margins negative (closest 4 mm).
stage: pT1c pN0(sn) cM0 (AJCC 8th edition). Anatomic stage IA; pathological prognostic stage IA.
genomic_risk: 21-gene Recurrence Score 14 is low genomic risk; in a postmenopausal, node-negative patient this predicts no meaningful benefit from adding chemotherapy (TAILORx).
chemotherapy_decision: Adjuvant chemotherapy is not indicated: node-negative (0/2 sentinel nodes), postmenopausal, Recurrence Score 14. Grade 2 and Ki-67 15% do not override the low genomic risk.
endocrine_therapy: Adjuvant endocrine therapy with an aromatase inhibitor (anastrozole, letrozole or exemestane) for 5 years; extended therapy up to 10 years may be considered based on tolerance and risk. Tamoxifen is an acceptable alternative if an aromatase inhibitor is not tolerated. Add adjuvant trastuzumab for 1 year because HER2 is expressed.
radiotherapy: Whole-breast radiotherapy after lumpectomy (hypofractionated). Partial-breast irradiation is a reasonable alternative given age, tumor size, negative margins and node-negative disease.
supportive_monitoring: Baseline DEXA bone density scan before starting the aromatase inhibitor, calcium and vitamin D supplementation, weight-bearing exercise, and repeat bone-health monitoring on therapy.
missing_information: Patient preferences and goals regarding endocrine therapy and radiotherapy
Expected tolerance of aromatase inhibitor side effects (arthralgia, bone loss)
